Brennt den Kessel gezielt aus, bis weder: Burns the boiler out until neither embers nor unburnt fuel remain in the burner - after that it is ready for cleaning. This is how you shut the boiler down before cleaning, maintenance and service work. The process takes a while and cannot be cancelled.

Damit wird der Kessel ein- bzw. ausgesch: Switches the boiler on or off. Switched off it heats neither heating circuits nor domestic hot water - only frost protection stays active.

Der Kessel brennt den restlichen Brennst: The boiler burns off the remaining fuel and then comes to a standstill. This takes a while and consumes fuel. Really trigger?
Der Kessel fährt auf die eingestellte Ka: The boiler runs at the configured chimney sweep output and holds it for the flue gas measurement. Switching off returns the operating mode to ON; after 60 minutes the measurement ends by itself.
Der Kessel kehrt in den normalen Betrieb: The boiler returns to normal operation. A flue gas measurement in progress is no longer valid afterwards.
Der Zwischenbehälter am Kessel, nicht de: The hopper at the boiler, not the storage room. If the system reports „refill fuel“ it keeps heating until the rest is used up; at „hopper empty“ it blocks the burner.

Ab diesem Anteil Sonne gilt der Tag als: From this share of sunshine on, the day counts as a sunny day. The ratio comes from the PV forecast or from the cloud cover of the weather forecast.
Abstand über und unter der Heizgrenze. E: Margin above and below the heating limit. It keeps the heating circuit from switching back and forth when values are close to the limit.
Das Profil stellt alle Werte passend zu: The profile sets all values to suit the heating surfaces. Your own values below override single fields; “Restore profile values” removes them.
Die Automatik vergleicht jeden Tag Progn: Every day the automation compares forecast and measurement and shifts the forecast by the learned deviation. With the switch off, the raw forecasts apply to display and decision; learning continues.
Eine zweite Prüfung am Tag, etwa wenn de: A second check during the day, for example when the morning was dull and the sun comes later. Leave empty if it is not wanted.
Fällt der Raum schneller als dieser Wert: If the room temperature falls faster than this value per hour, a window counts as open. The automation then suspends its decisions for 30 minutes.
Fällt der Raum unter Soll minus diesen W: If the room falls below the setpoint minus this value, the automation ends the setback immediately.
Liegt die gedämpfte Außentemperatur um d: If the damped outdoor temperature is above the limit by the hysteresis, the automation switches the heating circuit to hot water only. If it is below by the hysteresis and the room is cooler than the setpoint minus 0.5 K, the circuit returns to its program.
So lange bleibt der Heizkreis mindestens: The heating circuit stays at least this long in its program or on hot water only before the automation switches again. A room that is too cold always takes precedence.
So viele Eingriffe darf die Automatik am: The automation may write this many interventions per day to the controller. The return to the program does not count and is always allowed.
Um so viel senkt die Automatik den Sollw: The automation lowers the setpoint by this much on a sunny day. The setback ends at the controller by itself, at the latest two hours before sunset.
Wie träge die gedämpfte Außentemperatur: How slowly the damped outdoor temperature follows the sensor. A larger value gives short afternoon warmth less weight. Guide values: radiators 5 h, mixed 15 h, underfloor heating 25 h.
Zu dieser Uhrzeit prüft die Automatik, o: At this time the automation checks whether a sunny day lies ahead and then sets the setback.
Über so viele Tage vergleicht die Automa: Over this many days the automation compares forecast and measurement and adjusts the forecast. A short window reacts faster, a long one varies less.
An sonnigen Tagen senkt die Automatik de: On sunny days the automation lowers the setpoint of the heating circuit. With thermostats in the rooms this is off by default: the thermostats only open further when the setpoint is lowered.
Wunschtemperatur für Temperaturfühler, °: Target temperature for temperature sensors, °C (empty: setpoint of the heating circuit)
